quest.title: Receiver of Friends From Afar: Part IV
quest.description: This is your final day of employment as a temporary chef. You wonder if this day will pass by peacefully...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x45, Mora x40000, Hero's Wit x4, Recipe: Right at Home x1

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: ...How time flies. My burns are almost healed now, so I should be ready to take back the kitchen tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: #You've really gone above and beyond these past few days, {NICKNAME}. Last day today — here's hoping we get through it without incident.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, why does Paimon feel like you just jinxed us again...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The day passes without incident...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, we made it all the way to the evening! It ended up being a pretty smooth day after all. Maybe it's because we've gotten so experienced at running this whole thing?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've come a long way since our first day on the job, haven't we? Back then, we were struggling to remember who ordered what... But everything's a piece of cake now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, but who would come by this late in the evening? Oh... Actually, now that Paimon thinks about it, Lyney and his siblings came around this time on the first day, didn't they...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: #{NICKNAME}? Paimon? Fancy seeing you two here!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Amber? And Eula and Mika, too! Are you here for dinner? Why so late in the day?

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: We just finished an escort mission for a merchant caravan. The original plan was to make do with some rations for this evening and continue our trek north towards Stone Gate...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: But Captain Eula brought up the fact that none of us have eaten Liyue cuisine for quite some time. We thought we might as well swing by the inn and see if we can still order something.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, so this is Eula's treat, huh?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: ...Ahem! We've been eating the same rations for the entire trip, so I simply thought it was high time we had ourselves a proper meal. Do you have a problem with that?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Good question, what should we get... Hmm? Wait a sec, why are you taking our order?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}'s been filling in for the chef here! You've come at just the right time — you'll be the last customers to enjoy {M#his}{F#her} cooking before the original chef takes back the reins!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Wow, really? Good thing Eula suggested we come here! I wouldn't wanna miss this!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: So, what shall we get? Hmm... I'm not as familiar with Liyue cuisine as I used to be. Mika, Eula, what are you in the mood for?

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Anything goes! I'm just looking forward to trying the Honorary Knight's cooking for myself. I'm sure it'll be a great learning opportunity for me!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: ...Something small, I suppose. We have to hit the road again after we eat. Beyond that, anything goes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wasn't it your idea to come here, though? Yeesh, this is like getting blood from a stone... Alright, guess it's up to you, Amber. You name it, we'll cook it!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Huh? Then I guess... Eh, I don't really mind either. Anything goes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh!

choices.text: The day still isn't over yet.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Anything goes, huh? Oh dear... This is a chef's worst nightmare. With no idea of your customers' palates, you're left to make a wild guess...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Still, now that you've worked in the kitchen for so many days, I have faith that you'll be able to figure it out. Go on, show them what you've got!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Let me think... What do they like? What could they be craving?)

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: #There you are, {NICKNAME}! Thank you for all of your hard work over the past few days.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: My pleasure... assuming I'm still being paid, that is?

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Hahaha, straight down to brass tacks, are we? Here, take it. I've thrown in a little extra as well — call it a bonus. Hard work is rewarded here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yay! It's like all the tiredness and stress have suddenly melted away!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I'm just lucky you only worked this job for a few days. At the rate you were progressing, a few more weeks and I think I might be made redundant!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, I for one look forward to enjoying your cooking many more times in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Haha, anytime! Bring some friends with you next time, and I'll show you all what Smiley Yanxiao can do when working with both hands intact!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great! Although... just to be on the safe side, cook carefully in the meantime! You may have just jinxed it again.

talks.objective: Bring the food to the waiting Mondstadters

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: ...Mmm, this is delicious! Perfectly seasoned, and even the rice is bursting with flavor!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Nothing like a piping hot meal served straight from the stove... I've missed this.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: #Hehe, you've put the finest Favonian field rations to shame, and that's no mean feat... So tell us, {NICKNAME}, what's this one called?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's called... um... Paimon's guessing we can't just call it "anything goes," right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Help, Paimon doesn't know how to explain this dish at all! It's got no name, and it's just basic ingredients, simply cooked...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Basic ingredients, simply cooked? Really? I could have sworn that you put something fancy in here, or gave it some kind of chef's magic touch...

choices.text: This isn't the finest dish in the world...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Not the finest dish in the world, but the one they need right now...? Okay, you've lost Paimon, what do you mean?

choices.text: You've been on the road for a long time...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: So you mean... we only think this is delicious because we're so hungry? Hmm, there's got to be more to it than that...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: ...Perhaps the fact that the aroma of freshly cooked hot food is a welcome change from cold, pre-prepared rations.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Ah, kinda like the feeling of waking up to the smell of freshly baked bread in the morning? That makes sense...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Yeah... It's almost like we're back at Good Hunter again...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? But Good Hunter's in Mondstadt... Why make a point of trying Liyue cuisine if you can't even taste the difference?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Oh, I'm not talking about the taste. I just meant that feeling of... comfort, you know? It's like the feeling of coming home!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Comfort... coming home... Well, Yanxiao did say we wanna make our guests feel right at home!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What makes for a tasty dish is highly subjective.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Everyone's got their own preferences.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But a chef caters to all comers...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Gotta put ourselves in their shoes...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: So in other words... the secret ingredient is "passion"?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Despite how terribly cliched that sounds, I'll admit that it holds true for this meal. Well played... Mark my words, I'll remember this recipe!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Okay, but you can't really have a recipe without a name, though, right? Have we come up with a name for this dish yet?

choices.text: I hadn't really thought that far...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Hmm... How about "Right at Home"?

choices.text: And you've only been eating field rations the entire time...
But it's the one you need right now.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Oil, salt, sauce, vinegar... Right, that's everything we need.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: #Why, {NICKNAME}, this year's off to a good start, wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Amber?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: ...Ah, sorry. I zoned out just now — didn't see you coming.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got something on your mind?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Yeah... That food you cooked for us just now — it reminded me of the meals my grandfather used to make for me. I thought I'd forgotten how they tasted, but it all came rushing back.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: He used to make Liyue dishes all the time. I'd do my Outrider training with him until the evening, and then wait patiently at the dinner table...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: ...I'd sit there, with the smell of delicious food wafting in from the kitchen, waiting for him to finally emerge with the goods.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Sometimes we'd have Eula around for dinner, and even though she'd always find something to complain about, I could tell she really enjoyed the food.

choices.text: Ah... so maybe she remembers, too.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: ...Your words, not mine. Don't ask her about it — she'll only give you another earful!

choices.text: And maybe that's why she suggested you come here for dinner?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Judging from the look on your face, you've already figured it out. Alright then, go ahead and show them what you've got!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: I'm sorry! I really can't think of anything off the top of my head... I mean, I could pick from the menu at random, but I'd feel more comfortable leaving the chef to choose.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Oh, one thing — I know I said I don't mind what we have, but no alcohol, please. Neither of them can drink... it's a real pity.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: I—I've still got some sparkling water here!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Back when I was on the expedition with the Grand Master, I was often put in charge of cooking.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Under the circumstances, I could only cook some pretty crude meals... But everyone still enjoyed them a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Maybe "passion" was the secret ingredient then, too?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: The rations we brought were adapted from my signature Moon Pies. To come up with something even tastier... I gotta hand it to you, you did a great job!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: ...Still, please do drop by and try a few Stormcrest Pies next time you're in town. I insist.
